title: WHATS-NEW-1 release file
description: One product release's What's new (framework WHATS-NEW-1, points 1 and 3a). Written from the version's RELEASENOTES entry for an admin, not a developer. Checked by tools/whatsnew/ConvertTo-WhatsNewMarkdown.ps1 -Check, which also refuses a commit hash or a SUP- ticket number in any text.

type.description: Shown as Fix-only / Feature update / Security.

summary.description: One short sentence on the benefit or risk removed, never on the mechanism.

new.description: New features, at most 5; an empty list shows 'None in this version.'

fixes.description: Fixes, at most 5 (group smaller ones: 'Smaller fixes: ...'); an empty list shows 'None in this version.'

title.description: The effect in at most 8 words.

text.description: At most 2 short sentences / 40 words, plain words, 'you' for the reader.

action.description: Optional: one sentence on what the admin must do, and where. Shown first on the card as Action needed. Leave the field out when there is nothing to do.
